title: Gossipsub tip advertisements accepted without chain-of-custody verification
description: transit/main.rs:141-220: gossip tip handler calls reconcile() and backfill() on ANY advertisement from ANY peer — no peer auth, no tip CID signature check, no CRDT chain-of-custody. Backfill currently stubs out, preventing injection, but once peer block fetch is implemented a Byzantine peer can inject arbitrary log entries if backfill does not independently verify VerifiedEntry signatures. The CRDT signature verification path must be hardened before backfill is wired live.
